notes: Two boards: 'periph' carries the pushbutton circuit (sketch with INPUT_PULLUP on pin 2); 'central' has no external circuit, only USB (uses its onboard RGB LED). The two boards link wirelessly over Bluetooth LE, so there is no edge between them.

Pushbutton straddles the breadboard centre gap at columns 8 and 10 (read from the image). Top pair of legs (side 1) are in the top half and are tied to GND through wire3 and the top negative rail; bottom pair (side 2) are in the bottom half and connect to pin 2 via the teal wire. The internal pull-up means no resistor is needed.

The breadboard image labels the top half rows f-j and the bottom half a-e; the catalogue uses bank 't' (rows a-e) for the top half and 'b' (rows f-j) for the bottom half, so ports follow the catalogue naming by physical position.
Exact rail hole numbers (tn.1 for the GND wire end, tn.8 for the short wire start) are estimated from the image; any hole in the same rail strip is equivalent.
Both USB cables are drawn plugged into the boards' USB connectors for power/programming; the host end is not shown.
